defs.zones: rim = within 4 ft of the basket; paint = 2PT inside the lane (|lateral| <= 8 ft, <= 15 ft out from the basket along the court length) and not rim; c3 = 3PT within 8.75 ft of the basket along the court length (14 ft from the baseline); ab3 = other 3PT; mid = other 2PT; L / C / R by angle from the basket: C = within 19.65 deg of straight out, L / R outside it.
defs.coords: ESPN coordinate_x / coordinate_y in feet on the full court (x -47..47 along the court, y -25..25), baskets at x = +/-41.75, y = 0; each shot is measured to the nearer basket (3PT attempts closer than 22 ft to it are end-of-quarter heaves taken at the far basket and are measured to that one).
defs.side: Both baskets are rotated onto one half court (lateral = y * sign(x)); L = lateral > 0, i.e. the shooter's left if the feed uses standard x/y axes. The broadcast orientation cannot be verified from the data, so L/R may be mirrored; it is applied the same way to players and defenses.
defs.fga: shooting plays that are not free throws, minus missed 'Heave Jump Shot' plays (buzzer heaves; ESPN's box score does not count them, so zone totals then equal box FGA); 3PT = points_attempted == 3 (agrees with score_value on every make); mk = made field goals.
defs.blend: blended = (cur + w * prior) / (att_cur + w * att_prior), w = k / prior games played; k = 10, k = 2 for a player whose last-season team differs from his current team; teams / league k = 10 games.
defs.fields: c = current [att, makes] per zone; p = prior-season [att, makes]; w = prior weight; s = blended make %; d = blended share of attempts; n = effective attempts (cur + w * prior).
